landing.heroTitle: Your AI rarely breaks in a single moment.
landing.heroBody: Sentinela surfaces inconsistency, behavioral drift, token waste, and structural instability before they become user-visible failures, support noise, or operational cost.
landing.heroProofTitle: See value before you prepare a dataset.
landing.heroProofBody: Try a sample analysis to see the exact diagnosis, alerts, and recommended fixes you will get from a real run.
landing.heroUploadBody: Start with exported JSON and get a first diagnostic in minutes.
landing.heroConnectBody: Move from one-off analysis to repeatable monitoring when your stack is ready.
landing.problemBody: Sentinela exists for the gap between raw logs and real governance: the place where drift, inconsistency, and waste accumulate before they show up as obvious incidents.
landing.problemClosing: Sentinela helps teams answer a harder question than "is the system up?": "is the model still behaving the way we need it to?".
landing.problem1Body: Long, repetitive, or unfocused responses inflate token spend without improving task completion.
landing.problem2Title: Logs alone do not reveal semantic drift
landing.problem2Body: A model can look healthy in throughput dashboards while quietly changing tone, structure, or quality.
landing.problem3Title: Inconsistency becomes user-visible before teams notice
landing.problem3Body: What starts as subtle variance eventually turns into support friction, trust erosion, and brand instability.
landing.problem4Title: Manual QA does not scale with production volume
landing.problem4Body: Sampling conversations by hand is slow, expensive, and too shallow to detect systemic behavior changes.
landing.metricsTitle: From raw conversations to operational signal.
landing.metricsBody: Sentinela turns conversation history into measurable indicators your team can act on: instability, wasted spend, overlap, drift, and emerging risk.
landing.workflowBody: Designed to make model behavior legible without forcing your team into another complex observability rollout.
landing.workflowStep1Body: Start with exported JSON or pipeline output. No heavyweight setup is required to run a first analysis.
landing.workflowStep2Body: Sentinela evaluates consistency, drift, overlap, structure, and efficiency across intents and repeated situations.
landing.workflowStep3Body: Get an executive-readable diagnostic with risk signals your team can compare, monitor, and improve over time.
landing.securityTitle: Security and trust matter as much as detection
landing.securityBody: Observability for AI only works when teams can evaluate behavior with discipline around privacy, access, and how sensitive data is handled.
landing.security1Body: The analysis flow is designed to limit unnecessary retention and keep handling scoped to what the diagnostic needs.
landing.security2Body: Built for teams that need visibility into model behavior without treating conversation data casually.
landing.security3Body: Authentication, environment separation, and protected application areas help keep analysis access controlled.
landing.security4Body: Sentinela is being shaped for organizations that need governance discipline, not just a prettier dashboard.
landing.pricingBody: Start with analysis, then grow into repeatable governance when the operational need is clear.
landing.footerTitle: Stop treating production AI like a black box.
landing.footerBody: Start with a free analysis, see where behavior is drifting, and give your team a more precise way to govern quality, consistency, and cost.

problem.h2: What you can't see is what hurts
problem.body: AI teams without observability fly blind — and pay the price in undetected degradation, inflated cost, and lost trust.

p1.title: Quality degrades silently
p1.desc: Your model responds, but answers gradually worsen between runs. Without observability, you find out from user feedback — too late.

p2.title: Token waste is invisible
p2.desc: 40% of token spend goes to verbosity, repetition, and low-value responses. Costs rise before anyone notices the pattern.

p3.title: Decisions lack evidence
p3.desc: You know something's wrong but don't know what, or where to act first. Intuition isn't operability.

platform.h2: Six signals that turn AI behavior
platform.body: Sentinela analyzes conversations and produces indicators your team can act on — not just monitor.

c1.title: Behavior Scoring
c1.desc: Composite score of response quality across multiple axes: consistency, completeness, format adherence, and behavioral drift.

c2.title: Drift Detection
c2.desc: Detects structural deviation from expected baseline, run by run, before it becomes a visible problem.

c3.title: Cost per Useful Outcome
c3.desc: Calculates the real cost per valuable response — separating useful tokens from verbosity and structural waste.

c4.title: Intent Clustering
c4.desc: Automatically maps intent patterns and detects when distinct clusters start producing overlapping outputs.

c5.title: Behavioral Volatility
c5.desc: Measures oscillations between similar sessions in tone, length, and structure — and flags emerging instability.

c6.title: Actionable Recommendations
c6.desc: Prioritizes findings by impact and delivers structured recommendations. Not a dashboard to interpret — a decision ready to execute.

how.h2: From raw data to decision in minutes.
how.body: Zero infrastructure setup. Zero code integration. Upload, analyze, act.

s1.title: Export and upload
s1.desc: Export your AI conversation history as JSON or JSONL. Zero code integration. Zero SDK.
s1.detail: Supports Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, LangChain, custom APIs
